display.purpose: Login welcome and large outcome screens — max one per view.

title.purpose: AppBar screen identity and card headings.

body.purpose: Instructions and snackbar copy readable between turns.

shadows.name: floating-feedback
shadows.purpose: Snackbars and modal sheets only — never on resting cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main forward action — guest play, resume match, phase advance.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7C5CFF; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 16px 24px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; border: none; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7C5CFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #6B4EE6; }

components.name: Surface Login Button
components.description: OAuth provider buttons on login — neutral surface with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-surface { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; background: #1E1E1E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 16px 24px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-surface:hover { background: #262626; } .ds-btn-surface:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7C5CFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-surface-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); padding: 12px 16px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; border: none; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7C5CFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Match Action Chip — Idle
components.description: Ready-to-tap action in the 2-column match grid.
components.css: .ds-chip-idle { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #1E1E1E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), border-color 0.2s; } .ds-chip-idle:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); } .ds-chip-idle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7C5CFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Match Action Chip — Used
components.description: Registered action with check — may allow undo on tap.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip-used"><svg class="ds-chip-check" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 16.2L4.8 12l-1.4 1.4L9 19 21 7l-1.4-1.4L9 16.2z" fill="#7C5CFF"/></svg>Usar Item</button>
components.css: .ds-chip-used { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.18); color: #7C5CFF; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; border: 1.5px solid rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.6); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-used:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7C5CFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-check { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Game Carousel Card
components.description: Home discovery tile with per-TCG accent tint and border.
components.html: ⚡Pokémon TCGToca para jogar
components.css: .ds-game-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #F7D02C 14%, #1E1E1E); color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1.2px solid rgba(247, 208, 44, 0.5); border-radius: 16px; text-decoration: none; min-width: 182px; transition: filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-game-card:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-game-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; background: rgba(247, 208, 44, 0.22); border: 1px solid rgba(247, 208, 44, 0.55); border-radius: 12px; font-size: 20px; } .ds-game-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-game-copy strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-game-copy small { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

components.name: Filled Input
components.description: Notes field and text inputs — surface fill, violet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1E1E1E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 18px 20px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #7C5CFF; }

components.name: Floating Snackbar
components.description: Match feedback and auth errors — floating with soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-snackbar { display: inline-block; background: #1E1E1E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 18px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }

narrative.overview: TurnWise is a phone-side companion during physical TCG matches. The visual system is built for mid-match glances: one calm focal point, dark surfaces that recede in dim store lighting, and Wise Violet reserved for actions that move the game forward. It inherits Linear's tool clarity — focused hierarchy, minimal chrome, confident restraint — while allowing playful progress without tipping into toy-like or aggressive gaming aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first (#121212 scaffold) with surface layering at #1E1E1E / #262626
Wise Violet (#7C5CFF) as the sole brand accent — CTAs, active chips, focus rings
Per-TCG accent colors on game cards only; never the global primary
Flat cards at rest (elevation: 0); borders and tint carry structure
System UI typography — weight and size do hierarchy
Match action chips as the signature interaction pattern (2-column wrap grid)

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: colorScheme.primary (Wise Violet) is for brand and forward motion only. Win/loss/warning always use AppSemanticTheme tokens — never repurpose primary green/red.

rules.name: The Game Color Rule
rules.body: Each TCG has a catalog accent used only on HomeGameCarouselCard discovery tiles. Match UI stays neutral + violet so switching games does not reshuffle the whole chrome.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: During an active match, the largest readable element should answer what phase am I in or what can I tap next — never marketing copy or decorative display type.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface is not modal, floating, or responding to direct touch feedback, it has no shadow. Nested cards are prohibited.

dos: Do keep match screens visually quiet — one highlighted phase, one primary CTA.
Do use AppSemanticTheme for win/loss/warning/timer urgency — never Wise Violet for outcomes.
Do maintain 16px screen horizontal padding for thumb reach consistency.
Do animate chip state changes over 200ms easeOut — respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do let each TCG accent color live only on home discovery cards, not match chrome.
donts: Don't use aggressive neon gaming UI — no cyberpunk gradients, glowing borders, or RGB spectacle.
Don't feel childish or toy-like — no cartoon mascots, bubbly excess, or infantilizing illustration style.
Don't build cluttered rulebook trackers — avoid dense text walls or judge-console density on phone.
Don't import generic SaaS dashboard patterns — no cream backgrounds, hero metrics, or identical card grids.
Don't nest cards inside cards — use spacing and typography to separate content instead.
Don't put gradient text or decorative glassmorphism on core app surfaces.
